preconditions.description: The number of vertices V must be between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: len(adj) == V and all(len(adj[i]) >= 0 for i in range(V))
preconditions.description: The adjacency list adj must have exactly V entries, each representing the connections of a vertex.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= i < V for i in range(V))
preconditions.description: All vertex indices in the adjacency list must be within the range from 0 to V-1.

postconditions.description: The output must be a sorted list of articulation points or -1 if none exist.

postconditions.expression: any(isinstance(x, int) for x in articulationPoints(V, adj))
postconditions.description: The output must contain integers representing the articulation points.
